kpis.statement: The programme serves 4,000 enrolled learners across 3 programmes.
15% of learners have been mainstreamed into formal school.
Across 40 centres the mean M&E score is 2.9 (of 4).

wins.statement: Girls are at or above parity network-wide (51.1% girls).
Attendance is fully recorded (100% coverage) and joins to each learner.

issues.statement: ABAL has mainstreamed only 15.8% of its learners.
Catchup has mainstreamed only 14.5% of its learners.
Innovation has mainstreamed only 18% of its learners.

actions.statement: 7 centres score Poor (below 2/4) — route field support here first.
Target cash support at the 130 poverty-linked dropouts — the largest addressable driver.
Life Skills and Science are the weakest subjects network-wide — concentrate teaching support.

dataQuality.statement: Synthetic demo dataset: every table joins on student_id / center_id, attendance & assessments are fully recorded, and all fields are populated.
These are generated demonstration figures, not the real programme data.
